galleries.title: Cosmic Time, Scale & Physics

galleries.title: Art, Pattern & Visual Language
galleries.intro: Geometry, ink, line, and color become visual worlds for Ganesha.

galleries.title: Rhythm, Sport & Performance
galleries.intro: Music, dance, sport, and festival energy meet in a gallery full of motion and performance.
